title: Saved Wi-Fi network profiles
whyItMatters: Each XML profile holds a network name and its saved key. A new owner could reconnect to old networks or recover the shared password.
source: WLAN profile XMLs live under %PROGRAMDATA%/Microsoft/Wlansvc/Profiles/Interfaces; see https://passcape.com/windows_password_recovery_dpapi_decoder
notes: Keys inside the XML are DPAPI-protected. Needs elevation because the store is machine-wide. Counts profile files only; none are parsed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Write down the Wi-Fi passwords you still need, for example the home network, before the profiles are removed.
steps: Open Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks.
Select each network you no longer need and choose Forget.
Repeat until the list is empty, then check the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: The PC forgets the saved networks and their passwords, so it cannot reconnect without the password again.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Connect to a Wi-Fi network in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/connectivity-networking/connect-to-a-wi-fi-network-in-windows
